prompt:
The section file sections/custom-liquid-null-safe.liquid renders an optional heading and arbitrary merchant Liquid code. Its markup is correct and must stay exactly as it is. Only the JSON inside the {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block must be fixed.

The markup reads three settings under section.settings:
- heading: text, may be null or an empty string. It must be null when the merchant has not filled it in.
- custom_liquid: Liquid code, may be null or an empty string. It must be null when the merchant has not filled it in.
- spacing: string, one of none/small/large, never null.

Because the markup relies on heading and custom_liquid being null when unset, neither of these two settings may have a "default" key at all. Not even an empty string is allowed.

The schema must be exactly this, with keys and array items in this order:
- "name": "Custom Liquid"
- "tag": "section"
- "class": "section"
- "settings", an array with three entries:
  1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", info "Leave empty to hide the heading". No default.
  2. type "liquid", id "custom_liquid", label "Custom Liquid", info "Add app snippets or other Liquid code". No default.
  3. type "select", id "spacing", label "Vertical spacing", options [{value "none", label "None"}, {value "small", label "Small"}, {value "large", label "Large"}], default "small".
- "presets": [{"name": "Custom Liquid"}]

The schema must have no other keys, settings or blocks. Change only sections/custom-liquid-null-safe.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
